description: One grouped coaching and notes disclosure (REQ-005; C16; G11, G21; R29, R36, R73) delivered through GroupExerciseCoaching (src/ui/exercise-coaching.tsx: a labelled section per movement, each its own guidance read and its own note writer, draft, save and error), hosted by BlockPanel and the AMRAP card in the shared WorkoutCard's coaching slot (src/ui/refinements/workout-card.tsx), on the real /review and /workout routes (JOURNEY-005), with the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=cards (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-005 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/group-exercise-coaching.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-C16-01 /workout: each grouped block ends with one Coaching and notes disclosure with a labelled section per movement, and its rows carry none

TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-C16-01 every grouped format — superset, circuit, EMOM, AMRAP, For Time and ladder — ends with one disclosure, and a standard block keeps each movement’s own

TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-R005-01 each movement keeps its own draft, writer, save and error: one save writes only its row, a failed save keeps its text under its own name, and its retry writes it
TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-R005-01 keeps the note of a movement the library has no entry for, and saves it
TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-R005-01 a resumed workout shows each movement’s stored note in its own section, and a blank note stays blank

TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > AC-R005-02 written guidance, blank guidance, no entry, loading and a failed read stay distinct, each in its own movement’s section, with no hide or replacement rule

TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > JOURNEY-005 opens Review, starts that same workout, opens the bottom disclosure and edits one movement’s note; closing and reopening keeps every draft
TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > JOURNEY-005 recovery: a failed save keeps its draft through close and reopen, its retry stores it, and no performed work is recorded
TASK-005 one grouped coaching and notes disclosure > renders the accepted gallery state cards with the actual disclosure at the foot of each grouped live card

check-02.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-005 --check check-02 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-005.spec.ts --project=mobile
